note: Zog,宠物护理所卖宠物道具的商人;作为花园访客时抱怨自己失去了味觉。大厅台词在 Hub_General/NPC_Message/Zog.json。

messages.raw: §fI have a big problem. I lost my sense of taste, now I can't tell the difference between a melon and a cactus...
messages.text: I have a big problem. I lost my sense of taste, now I can't tell the difference between a melon and a cactus...
messages.zh: 我遇上大麻烦了。我的味觉没了,现在连西瓜和仙人掌都分不出来……

messages.raw: §fEating enough of these surely should bring back my taste memories. Thank you.
messages.text: Eating enough of these surely should bring back my taste memories. Thank you.
messages.zh: 这些多吃点,肯定能把味觉的记忆找回来。谢谢你。

messages.text: My tongue is hurting for some reason...
messages.zh: 不知道怎么回事,我舌头疼……
